params.caption: 🎮 Justice: GTA 6 may be the duo's only video game soundtrack ever French electronic duo Justice, who wrote original music for Grand Theft Auto 6, probably won't score another game. A single from their GTA 6 soundtrack backed the launch trailer, and the project features Tame Impala, SZA and King Gizzard & the Lizard Wizard. 🕒 Nov 17, 2026 · 13:57 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer 👥 @RockstarGames 🎧 React if the GTA 6 soundtrack slaps · 💬 Favourite track so far? #GTA6 #Justice #RockstarGames #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
